warnings_checked: policy_check.py --repo wt/20-F028 --range ccfd68f6ac76..work/20/F028 --stack-base llvmorg-20.1.8: 0 FAIL, 0 WARN. Nothing to excuse.

Trailer finding from the worker (a blank line between Change-Note/Task and Co-Authored-By hides Change-Note from policy_check): reproduced. scripts/common.py:commit_trailers uses 'git interpret-trailers --parse', which by git's definition reads only the last paragraph of the message. So this is standard git trailer behaviour, not a parser bug, and it fails closed (policy_check reports FAIL 'missing Change-Note trailer'; it cannot let a note-less commit through). It is a usability gap in the harness: the attribution instruction ('end the commit message with Co-Authored-By') makes agents add a separate paragraph. Suggested harness change (not a blocker for F028): say in AGENT_RULES rule 7 / worker SOP that all trailers (Change-Note, Task, Test-Regen, Upstream-File-Edit, Co-Authored-By) go in one final paragraph with no blank lines, and/or have policy_check print a specific hint when a 'Change-Note:' line exists in the body but outside the trailer block.
